summary: One review round (independent Claude critique). No HIGH/Critical findings — the plan is sound: spawnMember is the real spawn choke point, buildLauncherInvocation is test-only, the $ sigil survives PowerShell single-quoting, and leaving the forensic spawn-prompt envelope unchanged is correct. Three findings (2 MED, 1 LOW) all resolved in the plan + stories.

findings.title: Regex CRLF + trailing-boundary blind spot
findings.detail: RUN:\n was covered but Windows RUN:\r\n could be missed, and without a post-token boundary a line-anchored path like /usr/bin could be falsely rewritten to $usr/bin.
findings.resolution: Rewrite contract now requires CRLF-aware \r?\n and a post-token boundary (?=\s|$). plan.md 'Rewrite contract' + stories US-002 AC1; added CRLF and line-start-path non-rewrite test cases to AC3.

findings.title: config.js re-export would break split-export snapshot
findings.detail: Adding rewriteCodexSkillMention to hooks/config.js fails tests/split-export-compat.test.js unless EXPECTED + count are updated.
findings.resolution: Contract now exports from actors.js only and the test requires it directly from actors.js (no config.js re-export). If one is ever added, the split-export snapshot must be updated in the same commit. plan.md gotcha #7 + stories US-002 AC1.

findings.title: Integration 'NOT slash-form' assertion too broad
findings.detail: A realistic preamble contains prose like 'The /implement-with-ralph skill manages…', so a whole-script absence check for /implement-with-ralph would false-fail even when the RUN: line is correctly rewritten.
findings.resolution: Integration test now uses a MINIMAL prompt (only the RUN: line) for the codex/claude/copilot launcher-script assertions, or asserts the RUN: segment specifically. plan.md gotcha #8 + stories US-002 AC4.

verifiedClaims: spawnMember is the only launch-path caller of buildLauncherCommand; spawn-member.js:188 and bootstrap-crew.js:217 both funnel through it (single-site rewrite covers all real spawn paths).
buildLauncherInvocation (actors.js:249) is test-only (callers: codex-engine-field.test.js, codex-spawn-bypass-guard.test.js) — not on a launch path.
codex positional prompt is single-quoted ('${initialPromptEscaped}', actors.js:228); PowerShell single quotes do not interpolate $, so $implement-with-ralph reaches codex literally.
CREWS_NO_LAUNCH=1 / options.noLaunch returns {scriptPath,noLaunch:true} after writing the launcher script (actors.js:2489-2491) — the integration test seam.
Leaving the forensic spawn-prompt outbox envelope (spawn-member.js:180) on the original /-form is correct (records lead intent).
